status: R1 filed for the AFC-1258 implementation commit a028eda, cherry-picked onto the staging line under AFC-1257. CTO R2 accepted a028eda on AFC-1257; the landing commit carries Reviewed-by: MediaTech (CTO).
whatTheChangeActuallyDoes: Adds a standalone forward migration that resolves the afc-public-reader policy by name, refuses if it is anonymous-linked or the residual read field set is not exactly event,id,registration_status,ticket_code, deletes only the one event_registrations/read row, and no-ops (NOTICE) when the row is already gone. Adds suite 104 public-reader coverage: anonymous-link refusal, exact-row transition with decoys, field-set refusal, rerun no-op, and probe hygiene. Does not touch 0069-0072 or the cutover runbook.
scopeOfTheClaim: R1 only. R2 is the CTO acceptance of a028eda recorded on AFC-1257. The live read grant was already removed during the AFC-1256 cutover with operator approval; this migration is the reproducible forward record and will NOTICE already-removed on staging.
